answer: An agent marketplace requires every identity to lock 100 stablecoins for 30 days before bidding on jobs, whether scheduling cargo at a wharf or mowing a meadow. Creating 1,000 fake agents therefore ties up 100,000 stablecoins; fresh names cannot bypass the bond. Even when computing costs reach their nadir, the attacker must finance that locked capital, so cheap account creation does not yield cheap access at scale.
